title: Playing piano in Billy Phillips's band with Thomas Benton
summary: He played piano in the band, trading instruments with the violin leader and guitarist Thomas Benton, fellow Garden District residents.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: When you were working for Billy Phillips, were you playing with the band or along?

Yeah. I played with the band. And this is what used to happen. I'm playing piano with the band. Now, first, he's leading violin. He's on his violin. I'm playing the piano. Thomas Benton, he's on the guitar. And sometimes be like that. Now sometimes it change around. And Tommy would be on the piano. See? And I'd be out then. So let's just change the minutes. And hands around. Tom lived up here in the garden. I did too. See? I lived up here on the drive to the second and third at the time. And Thomas lived a little further up. Tom had just been dead there about eight, seven, eight years. So ten years away.
